sources.title: ISO/IEC 4933:2026 Information technology — User interfaces — Unifying input actions across devices
sources.license_note: Public abstract/status only; standard text not reproduced
mechanisms_absorbed: canonical operations can be unified across device-specific input actions
cross-device consistency is about operation access rather than identical gestures

sources.title: ISO/IEC 20071-5:2022 Information technology — User interface component accessibility — Part 5: Accessible user interfaces for accessibility settings on information devices
mechanisms_absorbed: accessibility settings must themselves be accessible and usable
settings require discoverable access, modification, and saving

sources.title: ISO/IEC 24756:2009 Framework for specifying a common access profile of needs and capabilities of users, systems, and their environments
mechanisms_absorbed: functional access needs include user, system, and environment capabilities
access profiles can support cross-platform evaluation

sources.title: ISO/IEC 20071-23:2018 User interface component accessibility — Visual presentation of audio information including captions and subtitles
sources.status: Published International Standard; under systematic review in 2026
sources.license_note: Public abstract/status only; review status preserved
mechanisms_absorbed: visual alternatives to audio are a distinct media-access channel
caption/subtitle presentation must support different user preferences and environments

sources.title: ISO/IEC TS 20071-25:2017 Guidance on audio presentation of text in videos including captions subtitles and other on-screen text
mechanisms_absorbed: audio presentation of on-screen text is distinct from visual captions
multiple media alternatives can coexist for different access needs

sources.title: ISO/IEC DIS 20071-24 User interface component accessibility — Visual presentation of audio information in sign languages
sources.status: Draft International Standard under development; DIS ballot initiated 2026-07
sources.license_note: Draft and paywalled; public abstract/status only and never treated as a released conformance rule
mechanisms_absorbed: sign-language presentation is distinct from captions and non-language manual communication
presentation must account for sign-language users and visual access alongside source media
